interpretation: Adding repeated same-action schedules exposed one-shot behavior that the 145-case distinct-action probe could not see.
The failing cases remained deterministic; the defect was semantic incompleteness rather than nondeterministic execution.
BLOCK_DOOR and TRIGGER_ALARM could be resolved once but some later repeats could leave pending direction with no relevant module able to consume it.
The next repair should make incident modules reusable without weakening convergence or receipt evidence.
